sources.title: GitHub - raihan-js/demodoctor: Find bad robot demonstrations ...
sources.snippet: The problem Robot-learning teams say data quality matters more than model size, but controlled measurements are rare. This project injects known faults into clean demonstrations, detects them from signals alone, then measures policy success in simulation on clean vs corrupted vs auto-cleaned data.
